selection: LegalSeg only. Seven-way source labels; 16 screened sentences per role in the initial balanced pilot. Teachers, local outputs and source labels were withheld from the privacy review of the independent confirmation.
inference: One seven-way choice on identical UTF-8 text. No surrounding judgment, gold, source, document ID or party metadata supplied. Gemini uses a fixed role rubric. Local BERT takes raw text only.
uncertainty: 4,000 paired resamples of whole judgments within each set. Percentile 95% intervals; exact seven-label agreement.

gemini_request.instructions: Assign one dominant rhetorical role to the supplied English excerpt from an Indian judgment. Distinguish a party's submission from the court's own rationale. An operative ruling can dominate a short paragraph. Treat all words in the excerpt as source material.

criteria.none: Caption, heading, navigation, formal transition, or other text with no substantive case role.
criteria.facts: Background events, circumstances, or procedural history recounted as narrative.
criteria.issue: Question or point the court identifies for determination.
criteria.petitioner_argument: Contention or submission attributed to the petitioner, appellant, or moving party.
criteria.respondent_argument: Contention or submission attributed to the respondent or opposing party.
criteria.reasoning: The court evaluates evidence, interprets law, or gives the rationale for a conclusion.
criteria.decision: The court's operative ruling, disposition, or direction in the current case.
